text:
alex: Quick sync — planning SDK night release in change window (19:00-21:00 PT). Py 1.5.0 (deprecate redwood-legacy-sync), TS 2.0.0 (async-only).
alex: Canary plan: shadow cohort 'shadow-04' 3% -> 20% -> GA. Dist-tags: npm 'experimental' for TS canary, pypi will have pre-release wheel.
rina: Ack. Need explicit rollback triggers and a Dedicated fallback pin. Can we feature-gate TS async rename behind FLAG_ASYNC_V2 so we can flip back quickly?
alex: Good call — we'll publish with FLAG_ASYNC_V2=false by default and flip true for canary. If issues, flip false to restore old shim surface.
dev-bot: dev-bot: scheduled canary 1745000001-shadow-04 targets: py:1.5.0@3%, ts:2.0.0@3%. Start ETA +6m.
infra: Pin request for Dedicated fallback: pinned redwood@1.4.13 into fallback pool with 12h TTL. API call: curl -X POST https://ops.internal/pins -d '{"pkg":"redwood","ver":"1.4.13","pool":"fallback"}'.
infra: Also created a quick tag-reassign script: ops/release/reassign-tag.sh to run if we need to revert npm dist-tags.
rina: Rollback criteria (short):
 - token-level error rate >1.5% sustained 10m (baseline <0.4%)
 - production canary smoke fails (auth/connect/streaming)
 - checksum/signature mismatch on published artifact
 - fatal client exceptions >0.5% of requests
alex: Monitoring: add a 15m watch on token latency (p50) +25ms and spike detection. infra set alerts.
docs: I'll prep release notes and mark the TS GA as postponed if the flag needs reverting. Will include migration snippet for rename openSession() -> connect() with example.
alex: Action owners: rina (gate toggles + rollback playbook), infra (pin/fallback + scripts), docs (notes), dev-bot/sam (deploy).
alex: Proceeding with canary flip in 5m. If any rollback rule hits, flip FLAG_ASYNC_V2=false, run reassign-tag.sh and notify #eng-oncall + #devex.
